Can you play "Bribes" when someone else calls/plays a vote?
It says you can only play action modifiers on your own actions...

Can you play more than one action modifier on an action then?

thanks,
dustin

You can only play Action modifiers on your own actions and cannot play
more then one of each identical modifier (ie 2 bribes) but can play
multiple mods that are different such as a Bribe+Bewitching+Scorn of
Adonis
This does make me think about the merchant card of business pressure
as a reaction card might make it used.
Rory

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4nrej4$9...@newsbf02.news.aol.com>, Rader73 <rad...@aol.com> wrote:
>Can you play "Bribes" when someone else calls/plays a vote?

No.

>It says you can only play action modifiers on your own actions...

Correct.

>Can you play more than one action modifier on an action then?

Sure. You just can't play more than one of a given action modifier
(by the same minion).
